note: Strings are recalled from well-known real tool output (or quoted from tool documentation); none was captured byte-for-byte in this offline environment. Every entry is therefore marked verified=false and needs human verification against a real sample (see BLOCKERS.md, Needs human). Placeholders {name} stand only for run-specific values (ids, paths, names). Literal braces are doubled.
